shortcut_probes.cue: C plus a square nested in the inverse/cube
shortcut_probes.strategy: Ignore ODE; choose unique candidate that nests C + [a square in x] inside cube root, logarithm, or cube. Only plus sign and exponent/layout inspected.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: Uniform guess baseline is 1/5. The strategy ignores the equation and all numerical coefficients. A negative coefficient in the same separable family requires the minus-square candidate instead; the package fixes that assignment positive. Inversion recognition alone is relevant mathematics, but the unconditionally positive squared primitive is an incidental source assignment.
